intent_en: To illustrate the projected population growth in Sub-Saharan Africa by 2100 and the significant challenges this demographic expansion poses.
previous_intent: To illustrate the projected substantial population growth in Sub-Saharan Africa from 2019 to 2100 and the significant societal challenges this demographic expansion may present.
narration_support: While some projections expect around 2 .6 billion people, others reckon with up to 5 billion by 2100. Such growth would be a huge challenge for any society.
chart_support: Area chart showing population in Sub-Saharan Africa from 1950 to 2100, illustrating a sharp increase from 2019 to projected values reaching 5 billion.
evidence_note: The narration discusses future population projections (up to 5 billion by 2100) and the resulting challenges, which is directly visualized by the area chart showing population growth in Sub-Saharan Africa diverging towards 5 billion by 2100.
